# plan:nav-ssr-dashboard — deliverable, part 2: /login loop and localhost guard

Coder: pij-local-parakeet (coder/ssr-dashboard). Part 1 (item 1, `e37b1ea0d`) was published earlier. Both commits below were assigned by the prime as follow-ups found during item 1.

## Commits on main

| SHA | Subject | Full `just fft` (its own run, in my worktree) |
|---|---|---|
| `d65ea0930` | fix(web): serve /login to signed-out browsers when GitHub OAuth is on | green 16:11–16:19 (load 61→28): lint, build, typecheck every tsconfig, 7315 passed / 60 skipped, audit no high/critical |
| `9c8406b3e` | fix(web): decide "local" from the socket peer, never request headers | green 16:24–16:33 (load 48→25): same gates, 7322 passed / 60 skipped |

## 1. /login redirect loop (`d65ea0930`)

- **Bug:** with GitHub OAuth on, `proxy.ts` redirected every signed-out page to `/login`, including `/login` itself: 307 forever (ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS). The sign-in page's public assets were redirected too; the icon-theme manifest came back as HTML and `IconThemeProvider` threw.
- **Fix:** signed out, `servesSignedOut()` passes `/login`, `/icons/`, `/fonts/` and the touch icons. Everything else still redirects to `/login`, `/api/*` still answers 401, and all of it stays behind the bootstrap-cookie stage.
- **Test:** `test/unit/web/proxy-login-redirect.test.ts` runs the real proxy (OAuth on, valid bootstrap cookie, no session). It covers `/login`, the manifest, three paths that must still redirect, and API 401. Red before the fix (Location `/login`). The reviewer independently re-ran it: 2 FAIL at 574d871ca and pass at d65.
- **Live, exact-d65 OAuth-on build** (`chainglass-ssr-dashboard-login-oauth`, BUILD_ID `0V9K9-a2ujMfIPd8nLZRq`):
  - signed-out `/login` gives 200, the sign-in button is visible, nothing redirects to `/login`, and there are no error responses or console errors
  - signed-out `/workspaces` lands on `/login`
  - a minted Auth.js JWT reaches the workspace (200, sidebar)
  - files: `/tmp/ssr-probe/login-proof-d65.json`, `realauth-d65.txt`, `login-oauth-d65.png`

## 2. Localhost guard (`9c8406b3e`)

- **Bug:** Next 15+ never sets `NextRequest.ip`, so `isLocalhostRequest` fell back to the Host header and accepted a loopback X-Forwarded-For, both client-controlled. Next fills XFF from the socket only when the client sent none (`base-server.js:567`, `??=`), and only after the proxy runs.
- **Fix:**
  - `apps/web/src/lib/socket-peer.ts` patches `emit` on `http.Server.prototype` and `https.Server.prototype`.
  - For every `request` and `upgrade`, before Next's listener runs, it overwrites `x-chainglass-peer` with `<token> <socket.remoteAddress>`. The token is random per process and never sent to clients.
  - `isLocalhostRequest` trusts only a header that carries the token, and also rejects any non-loopback XFF hop (a reverse proxy relaying a remote client).
  - `instrumentation.ts` `register()` installs the stamp first.
- **Why it can't be spoofed:**
  - Overwrite: the client's copy of the header is replaced inside `emit`, so no listener ever sees it.
  - Token: a request that never passed through the stamp (queued while Next started, or reaching Next by another server) carries only a client-chosen value without the token, and fails closed.
  - Upgrades are stamped too (tested).
- **Live, prod build of 9c8 on a spare port:** `POST /api/workspaces/chainglass/files/open` with no file params, which stops at 400 past the guard and never launches.

| Request | Before (pre-fix build) | After (9c8 build) |
|---|---|---|
| localhost, cookie | 400 (passes guard) | 400 (passes guard) |
| LAN, cookie | 403 | 403 |
| LAN, cookie, `Host: localhost` | 403 | 403 |
| LAN, cookie, `Host: localhost`, `X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1` | **400 (bypassed guard)** | 403 |
| LAN, cookie, forged `x-chainglass-peer`, Host + XFF | **400** | 403 |

- Same spoof against `/api/remote-view/sessions` with a valid X-Local-Token: 200 before (seen 13:5x on the item-1 build), 401 `bootstrap-required` after. localhost + token still 200.
- `cg remote-view list` (CLI X-Local-Token): `[]`, exit 0.
- **Tests:**
  - `test/unit/web/lib/localhost-guard.test.ts` drives a real Node http server. It covers a 127.0.0.1 request, a reverse-proxy XFF, a LAN request spoofing the stamp header + Host + XFF, and a stamped upgrade, plus header-level cases (loopback ::1 / mapped, forged token, stamp not installed). 4/7 failed on the old guard.
  - The four test files that faked "local" with Host + XFF now use the stamp (`local-auth`, `envmatrix`, `log-audit`). The `.ip`-based cases moved out of `event-popper/infrastructure.test.ts`.
- **Docs:** `_platform/external-events/domain.md` (owner of the guard), `domain-map.md`, and the `local-auth.ts` header comment.

## Terminal gate (nav-wave-1), on each commit's own fft build

Private tmux: `D=/tmp/ssr-dashboard-tmux` (chmod 700), and `env -u TMUX TMUX_TMPDIR=$D tmux display -p '#{socket_path}'` named `$D/tmux-501/default`. Scratch sessions were made with `tmux -S`, torn down with `kill-session`, never kill-server. Server :3191, sidecar :4691.

| Check | d65 localhost | d65 LAN | 9c8 localhost | 9c8 LAN |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| xterm mounts, WS to sidecar | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| typing → shell, output streamed back | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| resize: `tput cols` follows viewport | 179→94 / 179→93 | same | same | same |
| overlay window strip: new window shown, click activates | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| console / page errors | none | none | none | none |

Remote view (`requireLocalAuth`) and the `cg` X-Local-Token path were checked on both builds: localhost token 200, no creds 401, CLI `[]`. LAN runs re-inject the bootstrap cookie without `Secure` (owned finding: prod sets Secure over HTTP).

Evidence: `/tmp/ssr-probe/term-login-*.json`, `term-guard-*.json`, `guard-before.txt`, `guard-after.txt`, `fft-login.log`, `fft-guard.log`.

## Builds kept for the reviewer

- d65 normal env: `/Users/jordanknight/substrate/chainglass-ssr-dashboard-login`, BUILD_ID `kedH4cbvJpb1SCptF6ZvW`
- d65 OAuth-on: `/Users/jordanknight/substrate/chainglass-ssr-dashboard-login-oauth`, BUILD_ID `0V9K9-a2ujMfIPd8nLZRq`
- 9c8: `/Users/jordanknight/substrate/chainglass-ssr-dashboard`, BUILD_ID `tkl-8emx4LhwpPDPlHV4e`

## Left / noted

- e37b1ea0d (item 1) still needs its reviewer verdict. Its delivery gate was "a full green just test", and both full runs above (on later heads that contain it) are green.
- Not mine and already reported: prod `Secure` cookie over HTTP on LAN; `/api/terminal` 500 with no tmux server; `/agents` prefetch 404s.
- The verify route's rate limiter keys on `X-Forwarded-For` (client-controlled), so a client can rotate it to dodge the limit. I noticed it in `log-audit` test setup and haven't changed it. It's a candidate for the same socket-peer source.
